evidence.text: The FORTRAN95 implementation uses an openMPI master–worker scheme. Workers generate candidates that remain usable only if they satisfy the current likelihood threshold. Ordering parameters from slow to fast permits the triangular transformation and extra fast-direction updates to exploit cached likelihood calculations.

sources.title: Cobaya: Code for Bayesian Analysis of hierarchical physical models

evidence.text: Components declare required and provided quantities. Interfaces and introspection determine dependencies and execution order; caching permits reuse when a parameter change leaves a component's direct and indirect inputs unchanged.

sources.title: Are we typical?

This makes provisional measure assumptions assessable without claiming they already follow from complete dynamics.
